status: Registered before any V3 result. Every value without a cited measurement is a simulation assumption, not a platform specification.

resources.n_max_basis: assumed number of clusters the actuation system can steer independently; not measured on a platform
resources.targets_per_cluster_basis: payload and dose are not modelled, so no capacity limit is imposed

deployment.entry: single catheter entry at the tree root (inlet station)
deployment.release_candidates: root plus every bifurcation station whose whole root path has lumen radius >= catheter_min_lumen_radius_mm
deployment.release_candidates_per_cluster: catheter-accessible candidates on the root path of the cluster's first target (the catheter is advanced along the route)

motion_model_for_planning.flow_for_planning: healthy-radius solution at the nominal 0.05 mm/s inlet speed; the realised flow regime is unknown to the planner

safety.d_safe_definition: centre-to-centre Euclidean distance; surface distance = d - 2 x 0.08 mm body radius
safety.d_safe_basis: existing simulator threshold (d_min = 2 mm); not calibrated against magnetic interaction measurements

mission.time_origin: catheter insertion at t = 0; deployment and release are inside the deadline

objective.form: lexicographic: (1) feasibility [coverage, passable routes, n <= n_max, deadlock-free schedule]; (2) J = T_pred + w_wait * W_pred + w_risk * R_pred; (3) smallest N whose J is within epsilon of the best J over N; (4) total cluster-time
objective.risk_definition: seconds of predicted travel in segments with lumen clearance below 3 body radii or against flow faster than 0.3 mm/s
objective.selection_rule: weights and epsilon are fixed here before the validation run and are not tuned on the test set
